trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies how often a new number series line is created.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor ofte en ny nummerserielinje oprettes.
trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Cadence - Property ToolTip
Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Cadence - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number to increment by when a new number is assigned from the number series.
trans-unit.target: Angiver det tal, som nummeret øges med, når et nyt nummer tildeles fra nummerserien.
trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Increment-by No. - Property ToolTip
Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Increment-by No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number pattern. Use CC for century, YY for year, MM for month, DD for day, Q for quarter and WW for week number, followed by the starting number, for example CCYY-10000.
trans-unit.target: Angiver nummermønsteret. Brug CC for århundrede, YY for år, MM for måned, DD for dag, Q for kvartal og WW for ugenummer efterfulgt af startnummeret, f.eks. CCYY-10000.
trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Pattern - Property ToolTip
Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Pattern - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number series that the pattern belongs to.
trans-unit.target: Angiver den nummerserie, som mønsteret tilhører.
trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Series Code - Property ToolTip
Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Series Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies how many numbers before the ending number a warning is given. Leave at 0 for no warning number.
trans-unit.target: Angiver, hvor mange numre før slutnummeret en advarsel gives. Lad feltet stå på 0, hvis der ikke skal være et advarselsnummer.
trans-unit.note: Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Warning No. Offset - Property ToolTip
Table No. Series Pattern NSHLG - Field Warning No. Offset - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: The pattern %1 must end with the starting number, for example CCYY-10000.
trans-unit.target: Mønsteret %1 skal slutte med startnummeret, f.eks. CCYY-10000.
trans-unit.note: %1 = the pattern
Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType NoNumberPartErr

trans-unit.source: The pattern %1 does not give every period its own numbers: the period starting %2 (cadence %3) produces the same prefix as an earlier period. Add tokens such as YY, MM, DD, Q or WW.
trans-unit.target: Mønsteret %1 giver ikke hver periode sine egne numre: perioden, der starter %2 (frekvens %3), giver samme præfiks som en tidligere periode. Tilføj tegn som YY, MM, DD, Q eller WW.
trans-unit.note: %1 = the pattern, %2 = start date of the period, %3 = cadence
Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType NotUniqueErr

trans-unit.source: The numeric part at the end of the pattern cannot be longer than %1 digits.
trans-unit.target: Den numeriske del i slutningen af mønsteret må ikke være længere end %1 cifre.
trans-unit.note: %1 = maximum number of digits
Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType NumberPartTooLongErr

trans-unit.source: The resulting number is longer than the maximum of %1 characters.
trans-unit.target: Det resulterende nummer er længere end maksimum på %1 tegn.
trans-unit.note: %1 = maximum length
Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType PatternTooLongErr

trans-unit.source: You must specify a start date.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType StartDateRequiredErr

trans-unit.source: The warning number offset is larger than the range of the starting number.
trans-unit.target: Forskydningen af advarselsnummeret er større end startnummerets interval.
trans-unit.note: Codeunit Create No. Series Lines NSHLG - NamedType WarningOffsetTooLargeErr
